guide_artwork: Original typography, system fonts, SF Symbols and geometry; no generated artwork.
guide_seed_behavior: Each new guide is installed once. Removed guides remain removed and can be found and added from the local catalog.
native_search: Native searchable toolbar, compact Search button, Settings, native cancellation. No pull-to-search overlay in the library path.
scroll_visibility: Toolbar hides toward later content and returns while scrolling back. Publishes only visibility changes.
pinch_close: Both page halves fold around the center before the closed cover travels to its exact source slot; reversible, with Reduce Motion fallback.
sync_scope: Guides distinguish local files, independent server collections, and Pro iCloud library/progress sync. Files are not merged between servers or copied by iCloud progress sync.
distribution_scope: TestFlight upload only; existing beta review and tester-distribution hold preserved.
physical_duo_visual_check: Not performed; compact and wide native captures and simulator interactions are the evidence.
